name: Irina Volkov
bio:
Irina's fascination with motorsport began during her childhood visits to local karting tracks outside Moscow. She excelled in mechanical engineering, securing a prestigious internship with a Formula 3 team in Europe. Her sharp analytical skills and innovative solutions quickly gained attention, leading to a role as a junior engineer. Irina's relentless pursuit of performance and ability to identify marginal gains set her apart.

After several successful seasons, she transitioned into management, demonstrating a knack for motivating teams and streamlining processes. Irina is known for her data-driven approach to problem-solving and her commitment to pushing the boundaries of engineering. She firmly believes in fostering a culture of continuous improvement and open communication, while holding her team to the highest standards.

Joining Team Penske as Technical Director, Irina aims to leverage her unique combination of technical expertise and leadership skills to deliver consistent results. She's known for her unorthodox approach to problem solving, often thinking outside traditional engineering paradigms, which has led to several breakthrough innovations.

physical.hairStyle: Long, straight hair, often pulled back into a neat ponytail with a few strands framing her face.
physical.description: Irina is of average height with a focused gaze and a perpetually thoughtful expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical diagrams and equations.
Insists on having a perfectly organized workstation, with tools and components arranged in a specific order.
Has a habit of tapping her pen against her teeth when deep in thought.
